options.approach: Check the precise structural theorem and its hypotheses against the definition in the question. If they match, conclude that the required absence of a least upper bound is impossible, independently of the quasitrace.

options.approach: Seek a matrix argument deriving the estimate from the 2-quasitrace extension. Applied to the successive differences, it would give N times eta squared at most C and hence rule out every positive eta.

options.approach: Focus entirely on constructing and verifying the endpoint example. Once it exists, scaling supplies every smaller positive eta, while quasitrace monotonicity excludes eta greater than 1/2.
